name: Sliver Queen
description: Entrusted with the Skyshaper and other pieces, but lets Karn take the Legacy.

description_citations.text: "The Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn explains to the sliver queen that he needs the Legacy to be whole.
timeline.quote: so do I need the pieces of the Legacy to make me whole.

citation.text: Victual Sliver (Stronghold, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Karn tells the sliver queen they are kinfolk, as he needs the pieces of the Legacy to be whole.

citation.text: Victual Sliver (Premium Deck Series: Slivers, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Karn encounters the Sliver Queen and claims the Legacy pieces.
timeline.quote: Karn encountered the Sliver Queen in her lair

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn persuades the Sliver Queen to let him take the Legacy artifacts.
timeline.quote: Karn convinced the Sliver Queen to let him take the artifacts and depart in peace

citation.text: "Karn", section "The Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Volrath takes a number of the Sliver Queen's brood away to study them in the Furnace of Rath.
timeline.quote: He then took a number of her brood away from her (and stuck them in the Furnace of Rath ) so he could study them.

citation.text: "Sliver", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn convinces the Sliver Queen to release the Legacy after Hanna realizes how the hive mind works.
timeline.quote: Karn was able to convince the Sliver Queen to release the Legacy to him

citation.text: "Sliver", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Rath, Greven il-Vec commandeers the Weatherlight and confiscates Legacy pieces for Volrath; Karn gets them from the Sliver Queen.
timeline.quote: the Queen let Karn take the Legacy from her.

citation.text: "The Legacy", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Karn claims kinship with the sliver queen.

citation.text: Victual Sliver (Premium Deck Series: Slivers, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

relations.note: Volrath brought the Sliver Queen to Rath.
relations.quote: he was so fascinated by these mesomorphic, hive-minded creatures that he brought the Sliver Queen to Rath .

citation.text: "Sliver", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Queen of the slivers, whose children are part of her.

pages_say.description: The lost queen from whom the last slivers claim lineage.
